capabilities: Compose vault content into rows-and-columns dashboard layouts stored as YAML code blocks
Render inline or linked charts through the Bases Chart plugin
Edit layouts visually with a widget editor modal, drag-to-resize columns, and an insert command
Embed notes, headings, or blocks using native Obsidian embed syntax
Display stat KPI tiles, link cards, headings, and arbitrary markdown widgets
disambiguation: Not a standalone metrics app; dashboards are YAML code blocks that live inside regular vault notes.
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Requires Obsidian 1.10.0+ for the Bases code-block API; charts silently degrade to a notice if Bases Chart is missing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to arrange notes, charts, and stats together in a rows-and-columns dashboard layout within a note.

relations.evidence: Requires the Bases Chart plugin to be installed and enabled.
Works alongside Bases, Dataview, Tasks, Canvas, and any markdown plugin
Works alongside Bases, Dataview, Tasks, Canvas, and any markdown plugin

summary: Dashboard builder that composes vault content into a 12-column grid inside a note, with chart, embed, stat, link, and markdown widgets.
